# Third-party materials

The tau2-bench benchmark and task protocol come from Sierra Research's MIT-licensed repository, pinned to commit b7ea9074c1cba482b30687fecdb5c8425fd6f619. Its full notice is retained in tau2_LICENSE.txt. The source URL and hash of each archived trajectory are in results/public_manifest.json.

SWE-agent historical trajectories and SWE-bench Lite outcome records are downloaded from their original public locations for analysis. Raw transcripts and benchmark repository code are not redistributed in this supplement; the source manifest identifies each artifact. Users must retain and follow the respective upstream terms when independently downloading or executing them. Derived per-task statistics are included.

The ICLR 2027 conference style and bibliography style, and the supplied fancyhdr/natbib dependencies, are copied from the official 2027 template archive. Original notices remain in the style files. The template is used without changing page size, margins, line spacing, or body font. The monospaced font is Computer Modern Typewriter to support the available TeX installation.

All scientific methods are credited in paper/references.bib. The independent contributed wincs module is separately audited and is not yet used for reported manuscript results.
